title: Children and Covid: Your Questions, Answered

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 你好，我是安德鲁·罗斯-索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at the
sentences.zh: 我为《纽约时报》旗下的每日简报《DealBook》报道商业和政策新闻。

sentences.en: New York Times.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市举行的DealBook峰会上现场采访一些商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的领导人，包括J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·

sentences.en: Lagarde, Zoran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 拉加德、佐兰·蒙达尼以及其他许多人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以实时观看其中一些毫无防备、未经剪辑的对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live-streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at nytimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我们将对部分采访进行直播，供所有人免费观看，网址是nytimes.com。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅用户，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并获得我们所有新闻内容一个月的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望你能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》节目。

sentences.en: Hello, Michael, and everyone at The Daily.
sentences.zh: 你好，迈克尔，还有《每日新闻》的所有同仁。

sentences.en: My name is Colleen Marshall, and I'm speaking to you today from Bethlehem, Pennsylvania.
sentences.zh: 我叫科琳·马歇尔，今天我是在宾夕法尼亚州的伯利恒与你们通话。

sentences.en: Hello, my name is Trenton Foster.
sentences.zh: 你好，我叫特伦顿·福斯特。

sentences.en: We live in San Juan,
sentences.zh: 我们住在圣胡安，

sentences.en: Puerto Rico.
sentences.zh: 波多黎各。

sentences.en: This is Eric Schreiber from Broward County in Florida.
sentences.zh: 我是来自佛罗里达州布劳沃德县的埃里克·施赖伯。

sentences.en: As school districts across the country begin to reopen for in-school learning amid a surge of infections.
sentences.zh: 随着全国各地的学区在感染激增的情况下开始重新开放线下教学。

sentences.en: I have two little ones, ages 8 and 11, who are about to return to school.
sentences.zh: 我有两个小孩，分别是8岁和11岁，他们马上就要返校了。

sentences.en: I have two young kids who are in daycare.
sentences.zh: 我有两个年幼的孩子在托儿所。

sentences.en: One is one-year-old, and one is four years old.
sentences.zh: 一个一岁，一个四岁。

sentences.en: No one dreams!
sentences.zh: 没人做梦！

sentences.en: Oh, sorry, he's three.
sentences.zh: 哦，抱歉，他三岁。

sentences.en: He's almost four.
sentences.zh: 他快四岁了。

sentences.en: Parents are anxious and apprehensive.
sentences.zh: 家长们感到焦虑和担忧。

sentences.en: My mommy anxiety is at an all-time high.
sentences.zh: 我的“妈妈焦虑”达到了前所未有的高度。

sentences.en: And they have questions.
sentences.zh: 而且他们有很多问题。

sentences.en: How dangerous is COVID to young kids?
sentences.zh: 新冠病毒对幼儿有多危险？

sentences.en: What symptoms should I be looking for in my kids?
sentences.zh: 我应该留意孩子出现哪些症状？

sentences.en: Should I be more or less worried if my children are unvaccinated, but they're under the age of five?
sentences.zh: 如果我的孩子未接种疫苗，但年龄在五岁以下，我应该更担心还是少担心一些？

sentences.en: Today, Kevin Roos spoke with our colleague,
sentences.zh: 今天，凯文·罗斯与我们的同事，

sentences.en: Emily Anthes, about the answers to those questions.
sentences.zh: 艾米丽·安西斯，讨论了这些问题的答案。

sentences.en: It's Monday, August 23rd.
sentences.zh: 今天是8月23日，星期一。

sentences.en: Hello.
sentences.zh: 你好。

sentences.en: Hello.
sentences.zh: 你好。

sentences.en: I like your closet.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢你的衣橱。

sentences.en: Yep.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: We were just saying it's a closet slash podcast studio.
sentences.zh: 我们刚才还在说，这是一个衣橱兼播客工作室。

sentences.en: So.
sentences.zh: 所以。

sentences.en: I'm familiar.
sentences.zh: 我很熟悉。

sentences.en: Yours is much better organized than my makeshift podcast studio, which was just like a bunch of shirts constantly hitting me in the face.
sentences.zh: 你的比我那个临时搭建的播客工作室整理得好多了，我那儿就是一堆衬衫不停地往我脸上拍。

sentences.en: Well, you're only seeing a select portion of the closet.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你看到的只是衣橱里精选的一部分。

sentences.en: Oh, this is the curated closet?
sentences.zh: 哦，这是经过精心布置的衣橱？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: This is the presentable part of it.
sentences.zh: 这是它能见人的部分。

sentences.en: I'm honored.
sentences.zh: 我很荣幸。

sentences.en: Emily, every parent I know has basically one thing on their mind right now, which is how to navigate this virus around their kids and the return to school.
sentences.zh: 艾米丽，我认识的每一位家长现在心里基本上都在想一件事，那就是如何处理孩子周围的病毒以及返校问题。

sentences.en: And so the team at The Daily started asking around the staff of The New York Times, looking for the person who was best equipped to answer questions from parents about COVID.
sentences.zh: 所以《每日新闻》团队开始询问《纽约时报》的员工，寻找最适合回答家长关于新冠问题的人。

sentences.en: And the answer kept being that it was you.
sentences.zh: 答案一直指向你。

sentences.en: Well, thank you.
sentences.zh: 嗯，谢谢。

sentences.en: I am flattered and honored by the vote of confidence from my colleagues.
sentences.zh: 同事们对我的信任让我受宠若惊，深感荣幸。

sentences.en: I've been a science journalist for 15 years now.
sentences.zh: 我做科学记者已经15年了。

sentences.en: And since I came to The Times in March, I have been covering this pandemic day in and day out.
sentences.zh: 自从3月份来到《时报》后，我就一直在日复一日地报道这场大流行病。

sentences.en: And lately that has meant diving into a lot of the research on COVID and kids.
sentences.zh: 最近，这意味着要深入研究大量关于新冠和儿童的研究。

sentences.en: And when The Daily asked listeners to send in questions about COVID and kids, we got a ton of responses, something like 600 people sent in questions.
sentences.zh: 当《每日新闻》请听众发送关于新冠和儿童的问题时，我们收到了大量的回复，大约有600人发来了问题。

sentences.en: So I have a big ask for you today, which is answer all of them.
sentences.zh: 所以我今天有个大任务要交给你，那就是回答所有这些问题。

sentences.en: No, just kidding.
sentences.zh: 不，开个玩笑。

sentences.en: We've basically organized them into themes, and we're going to play a few of them and ask you to answer them as best you can.
sentences.zh: 我们基本上把它们整理成了主题，我们会播放其中几个，并请你尽力回答。

sentences.en: Does that sound okay?
sentences.zh: 听起来可以吗？

sentences.en: Let's do it.
sentences.zh: 开始吧。

sentences.en: Hi, this is Alex from Lakeland, Florida.
sentences.zh: 你好，我是来自佛罗里达州莱克兰的亚历克斯。

sentences.en: My biggest concern as a parent of two young kids right now is the fact that they can't get vaccinated.
sentences.zh: 作为两个幼儿的家长，我现在最大的担忧是他们无法接种疫苗。

sentences.en: I am wondering why it is taking so long for the vaccine to be approved, even on an emergency basis, for children under the age of 12.
sentences.zh: 我想知道为什么疫苗的批准过程需要这么久，即使是针对12岁以下儿童的紧急使用授权。

sentences.en: Are there problems with finding enough people to participate in the study?
sentences.zh: 是因为很难找到足够的人参与研究吗？

sentences.en: Are there problems with the kids who've gotten the vaccine?
sentences.zh: 还是接种了疫苗的孩子出现了问题？

sentences.en: What I'm pleading for is just some sort of compass from Moderna and Pfizer and when we will be able to protect our little ones.
sentences.zh: 我恳求莫德纳和辉瑞公司能给出一个指南，让我们知道什么时候能保护好我们的孩子。

sentences.en: Well, unfortunately, I'm not going to be able to provide some magic date that everyone can circle on their calendar, but I think I can provide a little bit of clarity.
sentences.zh: 嗯，很遗憾，我无法提供一个每个人都能在日历上圈出来的神奇日期，但我认为我可以提供一点清晰的思路。

sentences.en: So what's happening now is that the clinical trials for children who are between 5 and 11 are still ongoing.
sentences.zh: 目前的情况是，针对5到11岁儿童的临床试验仍在进行中。

sentences.en: So the reason the vaccines haven't been authorized yet is because Pfizer and Moderna have not yet released the data from the trials
sentences.zh: 所以疫苗尚未获得授权的原因是，辉瑞和莫德纳尚未发布试验数据，

sentences.en: or officially applied for authorization to the FDA.
sentences.zh: 也没有正式向FDA申请授权。

sentences.en: Pfizer, which seems to be in the lead, the closest to being ready, has previously said that they plan to apply for authorization for 5 to 11-year-olds sometime in September.
sentences.zh: 辉瑞公司似乎处于领先地位，最接近准备就绪，他们此前曾表示计划在9月份的某个时候为5至11岁儿童申请授权。

sentences.en: There is a bit of a wrinkle, though, because recently the FDA asked Pfizer and Moderna to expand their clinical trials for kids.
sentences.zh: 不过，这里有一个小插曲，因为最近FDA要求辉瑞和莫德纳扩大针对儿童的临床试验。

sentences.en: Why?
sentences.zh: 为什么？

sentences.en: What's the story there?
sentences.zh: 这背后的情况是什么？

sentences.en: You may have seen some reports that some of the vaccines have been associated with potentially serious side effects, and the FDA takes that really seriously.
sentences.zh: 你可能看到过一些报道，称部分疫苗与潜在的严重副作用有关，FDA对此非常重视。

sentences.en: The good news is that the side effects are rare.
sentences.zh: 好消息是这些副作用很罕见。

sentences.en: The bad news is that that means that in order to really get a sense of how much risk there is and how likely these side effects are, you need to include more people in your trials.
sentences.zh: 坏消息是，这意味着为了真正了解风险有多大以及这些副作用发生的可能性，你需要让更多人参与试验。

sentences.en: So this was a precautionary measure the FDA took so that they could make sure that the trials were big enough to detect any rare adverse events that might pop up.
sentences.zh: 所以这是FDA采取的一项预防措施，以确保试验规模足够大，能够检测出可能出现的任何罕见不良事件。

sentences.en: And what would those side effects be?
sentences.zh: 那些副作用会是什么？

sentences.en: Well, so the biggest concern, I think, when it comes to kids is something called myocarditis, and that's inflammation of the heart muscle.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为在儿童方面最大的担忧是一种叫做心肌炎的疾病，也就是心肌炎症。

sentences.en: And it's been seen a bit in vaccinations for adults.
sentences.zh: 在成人的疫苗接种中已经观察到了一些病例。

sentences.en: It seems to be most common, though, in young males, so young men in their 20s as well as teen boys.
sentences.zh: 不过，它似乎在年轻男性中最为常见，也就是20多岁的年轻人以及十几岁的男孩。

sentences.en: And because of that profile, because it's more common among the younger adults that have been getting it, I think there's some concern that it might also be a side effect
sentences.zh: 正因为这种特征，因为它在接种疫苗的年轻人中更为常见，我认为人们担心它可能也会成为一种在儿童中出现的副作用。

sentences.en: that pops up in kids.
sentences.zh: 所以我想监管机构、公司和每个人都真的想确定他们是否掌握了这是否是一种风险。

sentences.en: And so I think regulators and companies and everyone just really wants to be sure that they have a handle on whether this is a risk or not.
sentences.zh: 而且所有这些试验，它们涵盖了所有年龄段的儿童，还是只有特定年龄段的？

sentences.en: And all of these trials, they're covering kids of all ages or just certain ages?
sentences.zh: 现在到底是谁在接受研究？

sentences.en: Who is actually being studied right now?
sentences.zh: 嗯，试验是以一种降阶梯的方式进行的，这就是为什么我们现在有12岁及以上人群的数据和批准。

sentences.en: Well, so the trials happen in sort of a step-down fashion, so that's why we have data and approval for 12 and up right now.
sentences.zh: 当这些数据反馈良好时，这些公司就转向了5到11岁的儿童，这很可能是我们接下来获得数据的儿童类别，

sentences.en: So when that data came back good, these companies then moved on to 5 to 11-year-olds, which is likely to be the next category of children that we have data for,
sentences.zh: 也是下一个获得疫苗授权的类别。

sentences.en: and the next category that have authorized vaccines.
sentences.zh: 然后公司将继续向下推进到更小的儿童年龄段。

sentences.en: And then the companies will continue moving downward to younger and younger ages of children.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 所以对于5到11岁的孩子，他们可能会在未来几个月，也许是今年秋天，得到关于疫苗的答案。

sentences.en: So maybe for kids between 5 and 11, they will have an answer about the vaccine in the next few months, maybe this fall.
sentences.zh: 更小的孩子可能需要等待更长时间，直到那一阶段的研究完成。

sentences.en: Younger children may need to wait longer until that sort of step of studies has been done.
sentences.zh: 所以根据你告诉我的情况，可以肯定地说，家长们要等到对孩子接种疫苗感到放心，可能还需要几个月，甚至好几个月的时间。

sentences.en: So it seems pretty safe to say from what you're telling me that it might be months or maybe many months before parents will have peace of mind about vaccinations for their kids.
sentences.zh: 我这样理解对吗？

sentences.en: Am I reading that right?
sentences.zh: 是的，我的意思是，很遗憾，我认为情况确实如此，因为另一件事是，即使这些公司发布了数据，FDA当然也必须进行审查。

sentences.en: Yeah, I mean, unfortunately, I think that's the case because the other thing is, even once these companies release the data, of course, the FDA has to review it.
sentences.zh: 我认为这预计至少需要一个月，甚至更久。

sentences.en: I think that's expected to take at least a month, if not more.
sentences.zh: 然后，当然，你必须推广疫苗。

sentences.en: And then, of course, you have to roll the vaccines out.
sentences.zh: 如果孩子还需要接种两剂，那么在等待第二针以及免疫力产生期间还有一个等待期。

sentences.en: If they're going to be two doses again for kids, there's a waiting period while you wait for the second shot and for immunity to kick in.
sentences.zh: 所以可以肯定地说，我们距离幼儿的广泛免疫还有几个月的时间。

sentences.en: So it is safe to say that we are months away from widespread immunity in young children.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 这正好引出了下一批问题。

sentences.en: Which I think gets us into this next batch of questions.
sentences.zh: 你好，我叫约翰·莱斯利，我住在康涅狄格州的罗威顿。

sentences.en: Hi, my name is John Leslie, and I live in Rowayton, Connecticut.
sentences.zh: 我的问题很简单，这种病毒对12岁以下的儿童有多危险？

sentences.en: And my question simply is, how dangerous is this virus to children under 12 years old?
sentences.zh: 有多少人感染了？

sentences.en: How many have gotten it?
sentences.zh: 有多少人住院了？

sentences.en: How many have been hospitalized?
sentences.zh: 又有多少人死亡了？

sentences.en: And how many have died?
sentences.zh: 你好，我叫卡桑德拉，我住在明尼阿波利斯。

sentences.en: Hi, my name is Cassandra, and I live in Minneapolis.
sentences.zh: 最近我看到几篇关于儿童医院病人爆满的文章，但我没有看到任何关于儿童激增是由于德尔塔毒株对他们更严重，

sentences.en: I've seen several articles lately about children's hospitals being overrun with patients, but I haven't seen any clarification on whether the surge in kids
sentences.zh: 还是由于目前大多数儿童人口未接种疫苗而导致的澄清。

sentences.en: is due to Delta being more severe for them, or whether the high numbers in children can be attributed to the fact that the majority of the child population
sentences.zh: 我只是想知道，与最初的新冠病毒变体相比，我们需要对德尔塔变体有多担心。

sentences.en: is unvaccinated at this point.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: And I'm just wondering how concerned we need to be about the Delta variant versus the original COVID variant.
sentences.zh: 所以这两个问题，以及许多类似的问题，归根结底都是：这种病毒对孩子有多危险？家长们现在应该为孩子感到多害怕？

sentences.en: Thanks.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我不想告诉家长们他们应该或不应该感到多害怕，但这场大流行和这种病毒极少数的亮点之一，

sentences.en: So these two questions, and a lot of others like them, basically boil down to how dangerous is this virus for kids, and how scared should parents be for their kids right now?
sentences.zh: 就是它似乎在很大程度上放过了儿童。

sentences.en: Well, I don't want to tell parents how scared they should or shouldn't be, but one of the very few silver linings of this pandemic and this virus
sentences.zh: 大多数儿童，尤其是幼儿，病情轻微，甚至完全无症状。

sentences.en: is that it does seem to largely spare children.
sentences.zh: 最近的一项研究表明，大多数孩子在不到一周的时间内就自行康复了。

sentences.en: Most children, especially young children, have mild or even entirely asymptomatic cases.
sentences.zh: 而且当症状出现时，看起来很像感冒或呼吸道感染，或者其他常见的儿童疾病。

sentences.en: There was a recent study that showed that most kids recovered on their own in less than a week.
sentences.zh: 儿童的严重和重症病例很少见，但确实存在。

sentences.en: And symptoms, when they do appear, very often seem like a cold or a respiratory bug, some other kind of common childhood illness.
sentences.zh: 到目前为止，大约1%的感染病毒的儿童最终住院，0.01%最终死亡。

sentences.en: Serious and severe cases in children are rare, but they do exiSt.
sentences.zh: 所以这些数字非常低。

sentences.en: So far, about 1% of children who get infected with the virus end up in the hospital, and 0.01% end up dying.
sentences.zh: 这些几率很低。

sentences.en: So those are very low numbers.
sentences.zh: 但当然，如果那1%或0.01%包括你的孩子，那并没有多大安慰。

sentences.en: Those are low odds.
sentences.zh: 所以儿童确实可能患上严重的重症疾病。

sentences.en: But of course, if that 1% or 0.01% includes your kid, that's not much consolation.
sentences.zh: 为了确保我理解正确，在感染病毒的孩子中，大约每100人中有1人住院，大约每10000人中有1人因此死亡。

sentences.en: So there can be serious, severe disease in children.
sentences.zh: 是的，根据我们掌握的数据，确实如此。

sentences.en: So just to be sure I understand, of the kids who get the virus, roughly 1 out of 100 ends up in the hospital, and roughly 1 out of 10,000 actually dies from it.
sentences.zh: 那么我们对德尔塔变体有什么了解？

sentences.en: Yes, based on the data that we have, that's right.
sentences.zh: 德尔塔变体比其他变体更糟糕吗？

sentences.en: And what do we know about the Delta variant in all of this?
sentences.zh: 德尔塔变体显然更具传染性。

sentences.en: Is the Delta variant worse than other variants?
sentences.zh: 据信它的传染性大约是原始病毒版本的两倍。

sentences.en: The Delta variant is clearly more infectious.
sentences.zh: 所以更多的人正在感染它。

sentences.en: It is believed to be about twice as contagious as the original version of the virus.
sentences.zh: 这包括孩子。

sentences.en: And so a lot more people are catching it.
sentences.zh: 事实上，它可能对儿童的影响不成比例，因为没有12岁以下的儿童接种疫苗。

sentences.en: That includes kids.
sentences.zh: 而这种病毒，德尔塔毒株，主要寻找的就是未接种疫苗的人。

sentences.en: And in fact, it may be disproportionately affecting kids because no children under 12 are vaccinated.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And this virus and Delta is really mostly seeking out unvaccinated people.
sentences.zh: 关于它是否会导致更严重疾病的问题，稍微有点难说。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 科学家们认为，德尔塔导致更严重疾病当然是有可能的。

sentences.en: The question of whether or not it causes more severe disease is a little bit harder to say.
sentences.zh: 我们只是还没有足够的数据来支持这一点。

sentences.en: Scientists think it is certainly possible that Delta is causing more severe disease.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: We just don't quite have the data to back that up yet.
sentences.zh: 我想进入我们收到的下一组问题，关于长新冠或这种病毒对儿童的长期影响。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 你好，我是海蒂·盖伯森，我住在纽约皇后区的阿斯托里亚。

sentences.en: I want to move on to the next set of questions we got, which were about long COVID or the kind of long-term effects of this virus in kids.
sentences.zh: 我是一个四岁孩子的妈妈，长新冠是让我彻夜难眠的原因。

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Heidi Guyberson and I live in Astoria, Queens, New York.
sentences.zh: 所以我很想知道是否有任何数据表明，如果孩子感染了新冠病毒，他们患上长新冠的可能性有多大。

sentences.en: I'm a mom of a four-year-old and long COVID is what keeps me up at night.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: So I'm wondering if there's any data that shows how likely a child will develop long COVID if they're infected with COVID-19.
sentences.zh: 是的，嗯，我们正在获得越来越多关于这方面的数据，它似乎遵循与急性新冠相同的总体模式，即长新冠

sentences.en: Thanks.
sentences.zh: 在儿童中似乎确实比在成人中发生的可能性要小一些。

sentences.en: Yeah, well, so we are getting more and more data on this and it does seem to follow the same general pattern as acute COVID in the sense that long COVID
sentences.zh: 是啊，我们在这方面收集的数据越来越多，它似乎确实遵循与急性新冠肺炎相同的总体模式，即长新冠

sentences.en: does seem to be somewhat less likely in children than in adults.
sentences.zh: 在儿童中发生的可能性似乎确实比成人要小一些。

sentences.en: Estimates vary wildly from study to study and some studies define long COVID in different ways.
sentences.zh: 不同研究得出的估算结果差异巨大，而且一些研究对“长新冠”的定义也不尽相同。

sentences.en: But I've seen estimates that range anywhere from 2% to 15% of children still have symptoms at least a few months after recovering from COVID.
sentences.zh: 但我看到的估算数据表明，有 2% 到 15% 的儿童在从新冠中康复后，至少几个月内仍有症状。

sentences.en: We don't have a lot of long-term data simply because this is a new virus that hasn't been around very long.
sentences.zh: 我们缺乏大量的长期数据，原因很简单，这是一种出现时间不长的新病毒。

sentences.en: I guess the other thing that's worth saying is that what we're lumping together as long COVID can be a bunch of very different symptoms and conditions.
sentences.zh: 我想还有一点值得一提，那就是我们统称为“长新冠”的症状，其实可能包含了一系列截然不同的症状和病症。

sentences.en: So one kid with long COVID might just be a little fatigued for a few extra months.
sentences.zh: 所以，一个患有长新冠的孩子可能只是多疲劳了几个月。

sentences.en: On the other hand, you might have a child who's struggling with what we sometimes call brain fog or difficulty concentrating for many months.
sentences.zh: 另一方面，有的孩子可能要面对我们有时所说的“脑雾”，或者长达数月难以集中注意力的问题。

sentences.en: And so those are quite different manifestations and there's still a lot to learn about what long COVID is and what it looks like over the long term.
sentences.zh: 这些表现大不相同，关于长新冠究竟是什么，以及从长远来看它会呈现出什么样，我们还有很多需要了解的地方。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们稍后回来。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 用一个月的时间突破付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么。

sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，今天就下载《时报》应用程序，获取 30 天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: So, Emily, we also got a lot of questions about schools.
sentences.zh: 那么，艾米丽，我们也收到了很多关于学校的问题。

sentences.en: We got questions about whether schools would open this fall, whether they would stay open, what kind of policies schools are putting into place.
sentences.zh: 我们收到的问题包括：学校今年秋季是否会开学，是否会持续开放，以及学校正在实施什么样的政策。

sentences.en: And I know you're not an education reporter, but what does the science of this virus indicate about schools, especially this fall?
sentences.zh: 我知道你不是教育记者，但关于这种病毒的科学研究对学校有什么指示，特别是在今年秋季？

sentences.en: Yeah, so I know in some ways it seems like we're right back where we started and that nothing has changed since we were facing these same questions about schools last fall,
sentences.zh: 是的，我知道在某些方面，看起来我们又回到了原点，自去年秋天我们面临同样关于学校的问题以来，似乎什么都没有改变，

sentences.en: but we actually really are in a very different place.
sentences.zh: 但实际上，我们确实处于一个非常不同的阶段。

sentences.en: And part of that is because we have a whole year's worth of research and knowledge about schooling and the safety of schooling during a pandemic.
sentences.zh: 部分原因是，我们已经拥有了一整年的研究成果和知识，了解大流行期间的学校教育以及学校的安全性。

sentences.en: Schools can be safe when they take precautions, particularly when they take several different precautions.
sentences.zh: 当学校采取预防措施时，特别是采取多种不同的预防措施时，它们是可以做到安全的。

sentences.en: So maybe they mandate masking and they have daily symptom screening and they have regular testing programs or they have some physical distancing or if they upgrade ventilation.
sentences.zh: 比如，他们可能强制要求佩戴口罩，进行每日症状筛查，开展定期检测项目，或者保持一定的物理距离，又或者升级通风系统。

sentences.en: If schools do a couple of these things or layer some of these precautions, they can not only be safe but are often even safer than the surrounding communities.
sentences.zh: 如果学校能做到其中几点，或者叠加这些预防措施，它们不仅能做到安全，而且往往比周围社区更安全。

sentences.en: There have been some studies that showed that even when the virus seemed to be raging in an area, transmission rates were very low in schools.
sentences.zh: 有一些研究表明，即使在病毒似乎在一个地区肆虐时，学校的传播率也非常低。

sentences.en: On the flip side of course is Delta.
sentences.zh: 当然，另一方面是德尔塔变异株。

sentences.en: So the studies we have about school risks last year were conducted before this highly contagious variant was spreading across the U.S.
sentences.zh: 所以，我们去年关于学校风险的研究，是在这种高传染性变异株在美国传播之前进行的。

sentences.en: And so it's not quite clear yet what the risk of in-school transmission will be now that Delta is the dominant version of the virus.
sentences.zh: 因此，现在德尔塔已成为病毒的主要变异株，学校内的传播风险究竟如何，目前还不完全清楚。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And I think that the piece that's tricky is, you know, ideally we would live in a world where schools were taking all of the precautions you mentioned, but there are many schools
sentences.zh: 我认为棘手的地方在于，你知道，理想情况下我们生活在一个学校采取了你提到的所有预防措施的世界里，但有很多学校

sentences.en: that are not making masks mandatory or even recommending them that they're not upgrading their ventilation, that they're not putting in place the measures that one might
sentences.zh: 并没有强制要求佩戴口罩，甚至连建议佩戴都没有，它们没有升级通风系统，也没有落实人们可能

sentences.en: hope they would.
sentences.zh: 希望它们落实的措施。

sentences.en: And so in those situations where parents are deciding whether or not to send their kids in person to a school that may not be doing its best to prevent the transmission of COVID,
sentences.zh: 因此，在那些家长需要决定是否让孩子亲自去一所可能没有尽最大努力预防新冠传播的学校上学的情况下，

sentences.en: do you have any advice for those parents?
sentences.zh: 你对这些家长有什么建议吗？

sentences.en: Unfortunately, I think those are not only tough decisions, but really personal ones for families that depend on a lot of factors.
sentences.zh: 不幸的是，我认为这些不仅是艰难的决定，而且对于依赖许多因素的家庭来说，是非常私人的决定。

sentences.en: So if there's someone who is super high-risk or immunocompromised in your family, you might decide that you would rather pursue a remote schooling option for your child.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果你的家庭中有超高风险或免疫功能低下的人，你可能会决定为孩子选择远程教育。

sentences.en: It may depend on the level of transmission in your community.
sentences.zh: 这可能取决于你所在社区的传播水平。

sentences.en: Do you live in a place where the virus is really surging right now?
sentences.zh: 你住的地方现在病毒传播非常严重吗？

sentences.en: It may depend on how much vaccination coverage there is at your school.
sentences.zh: 这可能取决于你们学校的疫苗接种覆盖率。

sentences.en: There are a lot of factors to take into account, and so
sentences.zh: 有很多因素需要考虑，所以

sentences.en: I'm not sure there's any one answer that applies to all families.
sentences.zh: 我不确定有没有一个适用于所有家庭的答案。

sentences.en: I want to switch gears here to a series of questions we got about a subset of much, much younger kids, kids who are not yet in school.
sentences.zh: 我想转换一下话题，谈谈我们收到的一系列关于更小年龄段孩子的问题，也就是那些还没上学的孩子。

sentences.en: I'm
sentences.zh: 我是

sentences.en: Mia.
sentences.zh: 米娅。

sentences.en: And I'm
sentences.zh: 我是

sentences.en: Ellen.
sentences.zh: 艾伦。

sentences.en: And we're twins from
sentences.zh: 我们是来自

sentences.en: Massachusetts.
sentences.zh: 马萨诸塞州的双胞胎。

sentences.en: I have a four-month-old, and I have a two-month-old.
sentences.zh: 我有一个四个月大的孩子，还有一个两个月大的孩子。

sentences.en: We were both vaccinated while we were pregnant, and we're both breastfeeding.
sentences.zh: 我们怀孕时都接种了疫苗，而且我们都在母乳喂养。

sentences.en: How much protection do our infants have from
sentences.zh: 我们的婴儿能从

sentences.en: COVID-19?
sentences.zh: 新冠病毒中获得多少保护？

sentences.en: Thanks.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: What do you think,
sentences.zh: 你怎么看，

sentences.en: Emily?
sentences.zh: 艾米丽？

sentences.en: Well, I have a cautiously optimistic, but perhaps slightly unsatisfying answer, which is we do know that women who are vaccinated while they're pregnant make antibodies to
sentences.zh: 嗯，我有一个谨慎乐观但可能稍微让人不太满意的答案，那就是我们确实知道，怀孕期间接种疫苗的女性会产生针对

sentences.en: the virus, and they pass those antibodies on to their children through the placenta.
sentences.zh: 病毒的抗体，并通过胎盘将这些抗体传给孩子。

sentences.en: We also know that women who are vaccinated while they're lactating make antibodies, and that those antibodies turn up in their breast milk and remain elevated for weeks, if not
sentences.zh: 我们也知道，哺乳期接种疫苗的女性会产生抗体，这些抗体会出现在母乳中，并持续数周，甚至

sentences.en: longer.
sentences.zh: 更久。

sentences.en: So both of those things are really promising pieces of evidence.
sentences.zh: 所以这两点都是非常有希望的证据。

sentences.en: What we're not quite sure about yet is how much protection those antibodies offer children and how long that protection might laSt.
sentences.zh: 我们目前还不完全确定的是，这些抗体能为孩子提供多少保护，以及这种保护能持续多久。

sentences.en: I know there's been some concern from some women who have had anxiety or fears about whether it's really safe to get vaccinated while they're pregnant or while they're
sentences.zh: 我知道有些女性曾感到焦虑或担心，怀疑在怀孕或

sentences.en: breastfeeding.
sentences.zh: 哺乳期间接种疫苗是否真的安全。

sentences.en: And the
sentences.zh: 而

sentences.en: CDC recently formally changed its guidance for pregnant and lactating women, and it now officially recommends that they go ahead and get vaccinated.
sentences.zh: 疾控中心最近正式更改了针对孕妇和哺乳期妇女的指导方针，现在正式建议她们去接种疫苗。

sentences.en: And there are likely a couple of different factors that went into that decision.
sentences.zh: 做出这一决定可能涉及几个不同的因素。

sentences.en: One is that we have an increasing amount of research that indicates the vaccines are safe during pregnancy and lactation, and two is just as Delta spreads and the risk of
sentences.zh: 一是我们有越来越多的研究表明疫苗在怀孕和哺乳期间是安全的；二是随着德尔塔变异株的传播，感染风险增加，

sentences.en: becoming infected increases, it's important to remember that
sentences.zh: 重要的是要记住，

sentences.en: COVID-19 itself poses all sorts of risks to women and children, and so vaccinating against it becomes even more important.
sentences.zh: 新冠病毒本身对妇女和儿童构成各种风险，因此接种疫苗就变得更加重要。

sentences.en: Okay, so now I want to ask you about this batch of questions we got that I would characterize as being pretty specific.
sentences.zh: 好的，现在我想问你关于我们收到的那一批问题，我会把它们归类为非常具体的问题。

sentences.zh: 我叫

sentences.en: Hi, my name is Lauren.

sentences.en: I live in
sentences.zh: 我住在

sentences.en: Raleigh, North
sentences.zh: 北卡罗来纳州的

sentences.en: Carolina.
sentences.zh: 罗利。

sentences.en: I live in
sentences.zh: 我住在

sentences.en: Kentucky.
sentences.zh: 肯塔基州。

sentences.en: Hi, Zach
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是来自

sentences.en: Bowman from
sentences.zh: 俄亥俄州兰开斯特的

sentences.en: Lancaster, Ohio.
sentences.zh: 扎克·鲍曼。

sentences.en: And I have two little girls.
sentences.zh: 我有两个小女儿。

sentences.en: My oldest is four, and my youngest is 16 months.
sentences.zh: 大女儿四岁，小女儿 16 个月大。

sentences.en: We're considering enrolling our daughter in preschool for the first time.
sentences.zh: 我们正在考虑第一次送女儿去上幼儿园。

sentences.en: She's three.
sentences.zh: 她三岁。

sentences.en: She's very excited about it.
sentences.zh: 她对此非常兴奋。

sentences.en: We have a 17-month old who is unvaccinated.
sentences.zh: 我们还有一个 17 个月大的孩子，没有接种疫苗。

sentences.en: And my main question is regarding how to assess risk and decisions around her because she can't mask.
sentences.zh: 我的主要问题是关于如何评估风险以及围绕她的决定，因为她无法佩戴口罩。

sentences.en: She's missed out on many things because of COVID, but because of the Delta variants and the extra risks that are coming with that, we're just concerned that maybe now is not
sentences.zh: 因为新冠，她错过了很多事情，但由于德尔塔变异株以及随之而来的额外风险，我们只是担心现在可能不是

sentences.en: the right time.
sentences.zh: 合适的时机。

sentences.en: Our oldest, she's great with masking.
sentences.zh: 我们的大女儿，她很擅长佩戴口罩。

sentences.en: We feel comfortable sending her back to preschool, but are starting to second guess whether it's safe to send our little one to daycare.
sentences.zh: 我们觉得送她回幼儿园很放心，但开始怀疑送我们的小女儿去日托中心是否安全。

sentences.en: When she's not going to be in preschool, she'll be watched by her grandmother and grandfather who has recently recovered from lymphoma as in remission.
sentences.zh: 当她不去幼儿园时，她将由祖母和最近刚从淋巴瘤中康复、处于缓解期的祖父照看。

sentences.en: But even though he's received vaccine, he actually cannot produce antibodies.
sentences.zh: 但尽管他接种了疫苗，他实际上无法产生抗体。

sentences.en: Sort of leaves us in a limbo, not totally understanding the risk factors and just making us less confident in our decision making about moving forward with our life.
sentences.zh: 这让我们陷入了困境，无法完全理解风险因素，这让我们在决定如何继续生活时信心不足。

sentences.en: So we're just worried that by jumping back into school that we might be putting our family at risk by doing so.
sentences.zh: 所以我们只是担心，如果贸然回到学校，可能会让我们的家庭处于危险之中。

sentences.en: Any clarity on that would be wonderful.
sentences.zh: 如果能对此有任何明确的说明，那就太好了。

sentences.en: Thank you so much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: So let's acknowledge right up front that no two family situations are the same, no two school districts are the same, no two situations are the same with respect to making
sentences.zh: 首先我们要承认，没有两个家庭的情况是完全相同的，没有两个学区是完全相同的，在做出关于这种病毒的决定时，

sentences.en: decisions about this virus.
sentences.zh: 没有两种情况是完全相同的。

sentences.en: But I guess what I heard in these questions, aside from what do I do about my specific situation, is some version of a question like, how the heck am I supposed to even make
sentences.zh: 但我认为我在这些问题中听到的是，除了“我该如何处理我的具体情况”之外，还有一种类似的问题：我到底该如何为我的孩子做出决定？

sentences.en: decisions about my kids right now?
sentences.zh: 是否有可能查看数据、听取专家的意见，并做出一个你可以非常有信心的好决定？

sentences.en: Is it possible to look at the data and listen to the experts and make a good decision that you can have a lot of confidence in?
sentences.zh: 还是说家长们只能摸着石头过河？

sentences.en: Or are parents just supposed to kind of fumble their way through it?
sentences.zh: 嗯，我想我首先要说的是，

sentences.en: Well, I guess the first thing I want to say is to
sentences.zh: 要肯定这些家长，以及所有没能让问题被选中的家长，这些决定让人感到极其痛苦，因为它们确实是极其痛苦的决定。

sentences.en: validate these and all the other parents who didn't have their questions make it on that these feel like excruciating decisions because they are excruciating decisions.
sentences.zh: 而且这些情况往往没有完美的解决方案或答案。

sentences.en: And these are often situations in which there is no great solution or answer.
sentences.zh: 所以我同情这些家长，我理解他们的恐惧和焦虑。

sentences.en: So I feel for these parents and I understand the fear and anxiety.
sentences.zh: 我想我能提供的指导是，我认为最有帮助的方法是让家庭共同决定他们的首要任务是什么。

sentences.en: I guess the guidance I would provide is that I think the most helpful approach is for families to decide together what their top priority is.
sentences.zh: 他们的首要任务是不惜一切代价防止孩子感染病毒吗？

sentences.en: Is their top priority to keep their child from getting infected with the virus at all costs?
sentences.zh: 或者他们的首要任务是防止孩子把病毒带回家，或者传染给年长或免疫功能低下的亲属？

sentences.en: Or maybe their top priority is to keep their child from bringing the virus home or passing it on to an elderly or immunocompromised relative.
sentences.zh: 又或者他们的首要任务只是确保孩子今年不会落后？

sentences.en: Or maybe their priority is just to make sure that their kid doesn't fall
sentences.zh: 一旦你决定了首要任务是什么，剩下的决定就可以顺理成章地做出了。
